channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Crise no Supremo movimenta Brasília em semana esvaziada no Congresso
item.description: The 2026 electoral week begins with a crisis at the Supreme Federal Court shaping the agenda in Brasília, while the National Congress remains hollow. Main presidential candidates hold public events during the Independence Day holiday, with President Lula attending official celebrations in Brasília and other candidates, such as Flávio Dino, active in São Paulo.

item.title: Em pronunciamento, Lula defende soberania nacional: 'Não seremos colônia de ninguém'
item.description: On the eve of Brazil's Independence Day, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva delivered a speech emphasizing national sovereignty and criticizing foreign interference, stating that Brazil will not be a colony of any nation. The address served as an indirect reference to relations with the United States, underscoring the importance of the country's strategic autonomy.

item.title: Flamengo aproveita empate do Palmeiras e assume liderança pela primeira vez neste Brasileirão
item.description: Flamengo took the lead in the 2026 Brasileirão for the first time after beating Remo 1-0 and the draw between Palmeiras and Botafogo, moving one point ahead of the second-placed team.

item.title: Lula defende soberania do Brasil em pronunciamento pelo 7 de setembro
item.description: President Lula emphasized Brazil's sovereignty and rejected foreign interference in political, economic, and commercial decisions during a speech marking September 7th. He defended autonomy in managing natural resources and reinforced Brazil's role on the global stage, linking independence to social rights.

item.title: Nikolas mira Lulinha em série de vídeos e resgata caso da GameCorp
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) launched a video series investigating alleged irregularities in the business trajectory of Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Lula em pronunciamento na TV: "Não somos e não seremos colônia de ninguém"
item.description: Lula defended national sovereignty, democracy and the use of Brazil's natural resources during the eve-of-Independence address. He emphasized rare earths, oil, freshwater and Amazon biodiversity as foundations for technological development and job creation. The president also stressed free trade, autonomy vis-à-vis foreign interests and the fight against hunger, poverty and inequality.

item.title: Zema propõe poupança de R$ 1.000 para crianças nascidas no Brasil
item.description: Romeu Zema proposed creating a savings account of R$ 1,000 for Brazilian children, funded with resources from corruption-fighting funds, as part of the Sócios do Brasil program. The measure, estimated at R$ 2.5 billion annually, would invest the money in equity funds for 18 years, allowing withdrawal upon reaching adulthood.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira divulga vídeo nas redes sobre investigação contra Lulinha
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) released the first of seven videos investigating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, suspected of influence trafficking. In the episode, Nikolas criticizes Lulinha's lifestyle in Spain and recalls the Lava Jato case dismissal due to Sergio Moro's alleged bias. The release comes amid the scandal over leaked audio of Nikolas soliciting money from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master.

item.title: Lula defende soberania em pronunciamento do 7 de Setembro a um mês da eleição: ‘Não seremos colônia’
item.description: President Lula delivered a speech on September 7th to reaffirm Brazil's sovereignty and criticized U.S. tariffs, emphasizing the importance of not becoming a foreign colony. He highlighted the need to protect national natural resources such as oil and rare earth minerals, stating that Brazil's decisions belong to its people. The speech content was approved by the TSE to avoid electoral risks.

item.title: Cripta com restos mortais de D. Pedro 1º reabre no 7 de Setembro
item.description: The Imperial Crypt, housing the remains of D. Pedro I, will reopen to the public on September 7, 2026, commemorating 204 years of Brazil's independence. Following R$5.3 million in renovation works, the site will offer free guided tours and an exhibition on its historical background.

item.title: Lula faz defesa da soberania em pronunciamento na TV: ‘Não somos e não seremos colônia de ninguém’
item.description: President Lula used the Independence Day address to criticize U.S. foreign policy and emphasize national sovereignty, highlighting strategic natural resources such as rare earth minerals and oil from the Equatorial Margin. He defended free trade and asserted that Brazilian decisions belong solely to the Brazilian people, reinforcing his campaign stance against U.S. tariffs.

item.title: “Não seremos colônia de ninguém”, diz Lula em pronunciamento
item.description: President Lula used the September 7 broadcast to emphasize national sovereignty as a re-election pillar, criticizing foreign influence and highlighting natural resources. The speech avoids direct references to Donald Trump but underscores contrast with PL and the Bolsonaro clan. The military parade will be more moderate but saw a 33% budget increase.

item.title: Leia a íntegra e assista ao vídeo do discurso de 7 de Setembro de Lula
item.description: Lula emphasizes national sovereignty in his September 7 speech, asserting Brazil will not be a colony of anyone and highlighting the role of natural resources such as oil and minerals for the country's development. He reinforces resistance to foreign influence and promises to use these resources to generate technology and employment.

item.title: Em pronunciamento do 7 de setembro, Lula defende soberania: ‘não seremos colônia de ninguém’
item.description: On the 7th of September speech, President Lula emphasized national sovereignty, highlighting Brazil's natural resources such as rare earths and oil, without directly mentioning the tariff imposed by the US. He reinforced the importance of free trade and harmony among nations, stating that Brazil will not be a colony of anyone.

item.title: Em pronunciamento pelo 7 de Setembro, Lula diz que Brasil 'não é colônia' e que decisões pertencem ao país e 'a mais ninguém'
item.description: In a 7 September speech, President Lula emphasized national sovereignty, stating Brazil is not a colony of anyone and should have autonomy over its trade decisions. He highlighted the strategic importance of natural resources, such as rare earth elements and oil in the Amazon Basin, for Brazil’s development. The speech was pre-approved by the electoral court to prevent legal challenges.

item.title: Lula adota soberania como tema de pronunciamento do 7 de Setembro na TV às vésperas da eleição
item.description: President Lula used the September 7th address to emphasize key themes of his administration and campaign, highlighting national sovereignty and the exploitation of strategic minerals.

item.title: Flamengo bate o Remo no Mangueirão e assume a liderança momentânea do Brasileirão
item.description: Flamengo secured a narrow away victory over Remo at the Mangueirão, with a goal from Samuel Lino, temporarily taking the lead in the Brazilian Championship. The match was played under difficult weather conditions due to heavy rain, but the red-and-black team controlled the game and defended the lead at home by one goal. This win boosts Flamengo's momentum in the tournament.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula faz pronunciamento em razão do 7 de Setembro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will deliver a 3-minute, 43-second address to the national radio and TV networks on Sunday (Sept 6, 2026), focusing on national sovereignty. This is the third such address by the leftist leader in 2026 and aligns with one of the thematic pillars of the September 7 parade at the Esplanade of the Ministries in Brasília.

item.title: Direita realiza atos em ao menos 15 cidades no 7 de Setembro
item.description: The right-wing will hold protests in at least 15 cities on September 7th, with the largest event scheduled on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, convened by Flávio Bolsonaro with the slogans 'Out Lula, Out Moraes'. The demonstrations bring together figures linked to agribusiness, politicians, and religious leaders, criticizing President Lula and Minister Moraes.

item.title: Botafogo avança por atacante ex-Chelsea e se aproxima de concluir contratação
item.description: Botafogo advances in the signing of forward Hakim Ziyech, former Chelsea player and standout of the 2022 World Cup with Morocco. A verbal agreement includes a two-year contract, with the signature expected after bureaucratic details are resolved. Ziyech, 33, leaves Wydad Casablanca and joins Brazilian football for the first time in his career.

item.title: PABLO MARÇAL AO VIVO | ELEIÇÕES 2026: TRE-SP DERRUBA INEGIBILIDADE DE PABLO MARÇAL
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court (TRE-SP) ruled to lift the ineligibility of Pablo Marçal, allowing him to run in the 2026 elections. The judicial decision is a setback for efforts to block his participation in the election, strengthening his political trajectory in the state. The case reflects debates on electoral rules and the eligibility of leaders with a controversial history.

item.title: Zema propõe R$ 1 mil de poupança para cada criança nascida no país
item.description: Romeu Zema, candidate of the Novo party for Brazil's presidency, proposed a R$1,000 savings account for every newborn, funded using anti-corruption resources (R$2.5 billion annually). The initiative aims to promote financial education and build savings among Brazilians, with withdrawals allowed at 18 years old. Zema emphasized this will be part of the Brasil Sócios Plan but did not specify funding sources.

item.title: MPF reforça cobrança do governo Lula sobre Discord
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry reinforced the appeal to President Lula for Discord to implement urgent child and adolescent protection measures, requiring compliance with Brazilian legislation. The MPF supports maintaining the suspension of live streams on the platform until security requirements are met in the country.

item.title: Veja onde assistir Botafogo x Palmeiras ao vivo neste domingo
item.description: Sports article about the live broadcast of the match between Botafogo and Palmeiras, this Sunday at 6:30 PM (Brasília time), at the Nilton Santos Stadium, valid for the 26th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. The content indicates where fans can watch the game.

item.title: Saiba como será o 7 de Setembro dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: Lula will attend the traditional Civic-Military Parade in Brasília, while Flávio Bolsonaro leads a protest on Paulista Avenue targeting the STF and Alexandre de Moraes. Other candidates including Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, Ronaldo Caiado and Augusto Cury hold events across the country. The September 7 holiday concentrates political attention less than one month before the first round.

item.title: Cruzeiro vence Athletico-PR e se mantém na cola do G5 no Campeonato Brasileiro
item.description: Cruzeiro defeated Athletico-PR 3-1 at Mineirão, staying close to the G5 in the Brazilian Championship. Matheus Pereira opened the score but missed a penalty; Lucas Romero and Kaio Jorge added goals, while Athletico-PR scored once. The team remains in sixth place, one point behind fifth.

item.title: MPE pede ao TSE indeferimento da candidatura de Pablo Marçal à Presidência
item.description: The MPE asked the TSE to reject Pablo Marçal's presidential candidacy, citing eight years of ineligibility and lack of prior party affiliation. Other candidates also filed suits, with Erciley Pires Santana highlighting the vice's alleged ties to organized crime.

item.title: Saiba quem indicou cada ministro do STF e quando eles deixam a Corte
item.description: The STF has 10 justices appointed by five different presidents, with Lula naming the most (4). The crisis between Moraes and Mendonça, involving PF investigations and procedural disputes, reignites debate over political influence on the Court ahead of 2026.

item.title: Em jogo eletrizante, Santos vence o Internacional e quebra tabu no Beira-Rio
item.description: Santos defeated Internacional 3-2 at Beira-Rio with goals from Gabriel Barbosa (2) and Oliva, breaking a visiting team taboo since 2008 and moving to 11th place in the Brazilian Championship. Internacional, with 25 points, remains in the relegation zone.

item.title: Com STF e Alcolumbre na mira, PL tem o maior número de candidatos ao Senado
item.description: The Brazilian Liberal Party (PL) leads the 2026 Senate race with 33 candidates, aiming to build a base that supports Bolsonaro-aligned agendas, including actions against the Supreme Federal Court and minister impeachments. The strategy includes backing Davi Alcolumbre, though relations soured after criticism of the STF. The PL seeks a majority to influence the Senate presidency in 2027.

item.title: Veja como foi o fim de semana (5 e 6) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: Presidential candidates were active over the weekend with rallies, door-to-door campaigning, and interviews. Flávio Bolsonaro visited an imprisoned ally and pledged to create 500,000 prison vacancies. Hertz Dias campaigned in Salvador focusing on Black voters, while Augusto Cury and Edmilson Costa had smaller-scale activities.

item.title: Caiado diz que STF vive ‘momento delicado’ e precisa ‘dar satisfação à população’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) claims the STF is in a 'delicate moment' and must 'give an account to the population,' criticizing the Banco Master crisis and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes's tenure. His judicial reform proposals include a minimum age of 60 for the Supreme Court, a mandatory quarantine after compulsory retirement at 75, and appointing four women to the Court. He also reiterated his promise to cut the Selic rate from 14% to 7%.

item.title: Zema propõe poupança de R$ 1.000 para cada recém-nascido e recurso viria do combate à corrupção
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party candidate for President, proposes a R$1,000 savings account for every newborn in Brazil, at an estimated annual cost of R$2.5 billion to the federal government. He claims the funds would come from fighting corruption. The initiative aims to foster financial literacy and savings habits from birth, with money invested in company stocks over time.

item.title: Saiba o que Zema, Renan, Caiado e Cury farão no 7 de Setembro
item.description: Zema and Renan will attend protests in São Paulo criticizing Justice Alexandre de Moraes, Caiado joins a civic parade in Goiânia, and Cury leads a walk in Rio. The São Paulo acts stem from Federal Police reports on Moraes' contacts with banker Daniel Vorcaro and contracts with the minister's wife. Local party initiatives are also expected across the country.

item.title: MP Eleitoral pede rejeição da candidatura de Pablo Marçal
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office asked the TSE to reject Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy registration. The PGE argues that Marçal is ineligible until 2032 and failed to prove the required party affiliation deadline, based on a court conviction.

item.title: Renan faz carreata em Fortaleza onde diz que CV o proibiu
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) held a caravan in Vicente Pinzón, Fortaleza, despite a prohibition by Comando Vermelho, refusing to accept criminal faction restrictions. Accompanied by Delegado Huggo, he toured streets, presented proposals and spoke with residents, reporting no retaliation.

item.title: Após faixa 'Fora Moraes' em ato de Ruas, Paes diz ser contra transformar crise institucional em 'panfleto eleitoral'
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) criticized the use of the institutional crisis at the STF as an 'electoral pamphlet' after a 'Fora Moraes' banner appeared at Douglas Ruas' (PL) campaign event. Paes argued that Minister Alexandre de Moraes must answer the accusations but rejected the political instrumentalization of the situation. Paes' campaign escalated attacks against Ruas, questioning his wealth and alleging nepotism, while Ruas sought Paes' disqualification in Electoral Justice.

item.title: Internautas ironizam comício de Lula em frente à Casas Bahia
item.description: Internet users mocked President Lula's campaign rally held in front of a Casas Bahia store in São José do Rio Preto (SP) on social media platform X, linking the venue choice to the retailer's financial crisis, which reported a R$10.1 billion loss in Q2 and filed for judicial recovery. Users blamed the Lula government for the closure of nearly 300 stores and the layoff of thousands of employees.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral pede ao TSE indeferimento da candidatura de Pablo Marçal à Presidência
item.description: Brazil's Electoral Prosecutor-General has asked the TSE to reject Pablo Marçal's presidential candidacy registration, citing his ineligibility until October 2032 and failure to prove party affiliation within the legal deadline. The opinion argues that a 2024 conviction by the São Paulo Electoral Court for improper use of mass media during the municipal elections would already be enough to bar his candidacy. The case will now be decided by rapporteur Justice Estela Aranha.

item.title: Nas redes, Augusto Cury critica polarização e defende políticas da esquerda e direita
item.description: Writer and presidential candidate for Avante, Augusto Cury, posted on his Instagram this Sunday (6) a critique of political polarization in Brazil. He argued that any government under his leadership should adopt 'the best of the right in the mind and the best of the left in the heart,' seeking to reconcile policies from both sides.

item.title: Bispo convoca fiéis para manifestações contra a corrupção
item.description: Bishop Dom Adair called on the faithful to fill city squares on September 7 to protest corruption and authoritarianism. He urged voters to reject vote-buying and vote on October 1 for candidates untainted by corruption, saying Brazilians want an honest nation.

item.title: Mendonça libera para julgamento relatório da PF sobre Moraes
item.description: Minister André Mendonça released the PF report on messages between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes for plenary vote. STF President Edson Fachin will decide when and whether the session is open or closed. Moraes filed a counter-investigation request against Mendonça for alleged abuse of authority.

item.title: Planalto e Supremo negociam preservar Moraes até depois da eleição
item.description: Brazil's Planalto, Lula allies, and a wing of the STF are coordinating to shield Justice Alexandre de Moraes from investigations into his alleged improper ties to Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. Justice Mendonça disclosed evidence of 52 messages from Vorcaro to Moraes, while Chief Justice Fachin postponed decisions, triggering what is described as the worst institutional crisis in the Supreme Court's history. The case also entangled the fake news inquiry, which Moraes used to add Mendonça before Fachin reversed the move.

item.title: Sob pressão nas pesquisas, Lula amplia embate com Flávio e critica postura de adversário em relação aos Estados Unidos
item.description: Lula releases a new attack ad targeting Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing differences in stance on international relations, particularly with the United States, amid a tight race projected for a second-round tie. The Petista campaign reinforces the narrative of defending national sovereignty, as recent polling shows Lula at 46% and Flávio at 44%, according to Datafolha.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve estrear canal 24h com conteúdo de campanha no 7/9
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) will launch a 24-hour continuous YouTube channel on September 7th, featuring campaign propaganda, live streams, and allied content, an initiative attributed to marketer Duda Lima. The debut coincides with Independence Day and comes amid pro-campaign rallies that also target Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes. Content will be hosted on the candidate's officially declared social media channels with the TSE.

item.title: Sem citar Fachin, Dino questiona plano de encerrar inquéritos “muito antigos”, como o das fake news
item.description: Justice Flávio Dino publicly questioned, without naming him, Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin's defense of ending the fake news inquiry, which has been ongoing for seven years. The criticism comes amid an internal crisis at the Court, following Alexandre de Moraes's request to investigate André Mendonça for his conduct in inquiries. An ally of Moraes, Dino raised a debate on whether a judge can promise the closure of long-running investigations.

item.title: Josias Teófilo na Crusoé: Por que as plateias estão vazias?
item.description: Paula Lavigne, producer and wife of Caetano Veloso, told President Lula that the live music sector is facing an unprecedented drop in attendance, the worst in her 40-year career. The Crusoé venue, hosting Josias Teófilo's show, has seen empty seats, reflecting the broader crisis in Brazil's live entertainment industry. She pointed to economic and consumption factors as key reasons for the decline.

item.title: A indireta de Flávio Dino ao presidente do STF, Edson Fachin, sobre o ‘inquérito das fake news’
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino publicly questioned STF President Edson Fachin over his advocacy for closing the fake news inquiry, raising concerns that a judge should not promise to end an investigation as a politician would. He also commented on the Court's monocratic decisions and its criminal jurisdiction, stressing the need for coherent reforms to redistribute cases. His critique blended legal, political, and electoral concerns, denouncing polarization surrounding the Judiciary.

item.title: Flávio cobra voto de Cármen Lúcia contra Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro publicly demanded that Justice Cármen Lúcia vote in favor of opening an investigation against Justice Alexandre de Moraes at the STF. The court is split 4-4, making her vote decisive since a tie favors the suspected minister. The case centers on messages between Moraes and businessman Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by the Federal Police.

item.title: Chapa feminina no DF mira projeto nacional para eleger mulheres até 2030
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, Bia Kicis, and Celina Leão are building a female political alliance in Brazil's Federal District with a national outlook, aiming to elect women backed by the former first lady in 2026 and project new candidacies through 2030. The strategy includes 14 state and over 100 municipal PL Mulher presidents running as candidates this year. Michelle's departure from the PL Mulher presidency after an internal defeat in Ceará shows the limits of her leverage, yet the broader project continues.
